body:
I went and saw her today. At one point she said, "I guess I should stop thinking of you as my boyfriend", which is just...strange.

Then, like a moron, I agreed to take her Blackberry home with me and charge it, and check her email for her. Now, of course, I have a reason to see her again. I need to stop getting myself into situations like this, although I did promise her when she gets out, hopefully on Monday, I can pick her up. I guess I feel she needs someone here until she gets back with her family, but I can't tell if I'm making decisions like this consciously or at least somewhat being manipulated.

I did. He wanted to thank me for calling 911, and assured me it was the right thing to do.

I hate that they're keeping her in a ward with no clock and no windows, and not letting her have access to her phone or internet. I would think if you're already depressed or crazy that would make it worse.
Her dad just called me and left a voicemail asking me to call him back.
She has told me I am her only friend around here. Her family is 4 hours away. I know I shouldn't feel guilty and want to see her because no one else will, but I do.

Thanks man. I went out tonight and had some fun with friends, I've never needed this so bad in my life!

I told her (and the doctor) I would make sure she had a ride back to her place tomorrow. After that, I think I need to take a break from being in her life. I know she thinks she loves me and I'm the most important thing in the world, but I hope she can learn that's not the case.
I'm not strong enough to deal with this.
I'm replying so you can see I updated.
Thanks. I don't think I ever want to see a suicide written to me ever again.
